Status: Wave 262 accepted (6.3): UserFile, Functions and Archive

Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. Three namespaces in one wave: Operations.UserFile (the create step of AddUserFileOperation, the DCA id text and the export/import/delete helpers of ExportDcaAsUserFile), Operations.Functions (the two halves of AddFunctionOperation, its progress reporter, CopyFunctionOperation's merge and MoveFunctionOperation's move) and Archive (the <Flatten>d__10 iterator, the root folder info construction and the recursive parent-folder walk of ArchiveProjectInfoProvider).
Method.themes: The compiler-generated state machine name <Flatten>d__10 confirms ArchiveEnumerator's iterator. The five Operations.Devices predicates (0x06004F8F..93) stay unresolved: all five bodies are one call to ResetParameterValuesToDefaultOperation::method_3 and all five are referenced only from SpecializedExecute, which uses them in five reset loops that differ only in the module-instance filter (SubModuleId null or not) and in whether the parameter collection is the module's or the device's, so no evidence separates the predicates themselves.
